definitions.explanation: A small organized group of people working together, often in schools, workplaces, or military.

examples.japanese: クラスを5つの{班|はん}に{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: We divided the class into five groups.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{調理|ちょうり}{班|はん}の{担当|たんとう}です。
examples.english: I'm in charge of the cooking team.

examples.japanese: {班長|はんちょう}を{決|き}めてください。

notes:
Commonly used in schools and organizations for dividing people into working groups.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{班長|はんちょう} (group leader)
・{班|はん}{員|いん} (group member)
・{救護|きゅうご}{班|はん} (rescue team)
・{調査|ちょうさ}{班|はん} (investigation team)

USAGE IN SCHOOLS:
・Classes are often divided into 班 for activities like cleaning, lunch duty, or group projects
・Each 班 typically has a {班長|はんちょう} (leader)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・グループ - more general term
・チーム - team (often for sports or projects)
・{組|くみ} - class or group
